_comment: How the publish stage uploads. 'private' is the default and the only safe one to start with: the video
is uploaded private, and you watch it before you make it public yourself.
'public' (exactly that word, lower case) releases a run that passes every check without a human in the loop.
Set it only after a run of private days you trust. Anything else in this file, or no file at all, is private.
A day already uploaded keeps its visibility when you change this. Keys starting with an underscore are notes.
